episodes.title: Rebirth (1)
episodes.summary: Fifty years into the future, a young Terry McGinnis meets the aged and reclusive Bruce Wayne even as the boy's father discovers a foul secret of his corrupt employer that leads to his death.

episodes.title: Rebirth (2)
episodes.summary: Determined to bring his father's murderers to justice, Terry finally impulsively resorts to using Wayne's last Batsuit to investigate as the new Batman.

episodes.title: Black Out
episodes.summary: A dangerous shapeshifter in the employ of Derek Powers is out to sabotage a competing company and Batman must stand in her way.

episodes.title: Golem
episodes.summary: A bullied nerd uses his newfound mental control of a giant construction robot to seek revenge.

episodes.title: Meltdown
episodes.summary: For his own reasons, Derek Powers arranges for Mr. Freeze to have a new organic body, but things don't go according to plan.

episodes.title: Heroes
episodes.summary: A trio of new superheroes make their debut, but they have dark secrets that lead to a disastrous crisis Batman must stop.

episodes.title: Shriek
episodes.summary: An inventor of a sound-based weapon plots against Bruce Wayne.

episodes.title: Dead Man's Hand
episodes.summary: Terry falls for a new girl, unaware that she is actually the supervillain Ten of the Royal Flush Gang.

episodes.title: The Winning Edge
episodes.summary: While Terry investigates the source of illegal performance-enhancing stimulants based on Bane's venom, his mother suspects he is using them himself.

episodes.title: Spellbound
episodes.summary: A new supervillain is manipulating victims to commit crimes for him using extremely lifelike illusions.

episodes.title: Disappearing Inque
episodes.summary: An enamored warder of the imprisoned Inque frees her and helps her in her quests for healing and revenge.

episodes.title: A Touch of Curaré
episodes.summary: Commissioner Barbara Gordon is determined to protect her DA husband from an elite assassin, and definitely does not want Batman, and especially Bruce Wayne's, help.

episodes.title: Ascension
episodes.summary: As Derek Powers' medical condition as Blight worsens, he calls his estranged son home for help. However, an enemy hidden in plain sight has other plans for him that eventually involve Batman as well.

episodes.title: Splicers
episodes.summary: Splicing genetics into humans is the new thing among the kids at Terry's school. The city wants to make it illegal due to overly aggressive behavior in the subjects. Batman is suspicious.

episodes.title: Earth Mover
episodes.summary: Jackie; a friend of Terry is being followed by a monster that seems made of soil and her "father" is not really her father.

episodes.title: Joyride
episodes.summary: When a prototype military vehicle with a disastrous flaw is abandoned and seized by Jokerz, Batman and the vehicle's creator must hunt it down before it explodes.

episodes.title: Lost Soul
episodes.summary: When a digitized consciousness of a deceased computer genius is revived, it starts causing havoc throughout the city before it decides to take over the systems of Terry's batsuit next.

episodes.title: Hidden Agenda
episodes.summary: A girl genius finds herself unaccountably harassed by Jokerz at school and she begins to suspect Terry is responsible.

episodes.title: Bloodsport
episodes.summary: Batman finds himself the quarry of an augmented hunter seeking the ultimate challenge.

episodes.title: Once Burned
episodes.summary: Batman finds Ten determined to rob a rich underground poker game supposedly to save her family and he struggles to decide whether to trust her.

episodes.title: Hooked Up
episodes.summary: Batman investigates a ring of troubled kids who are so addicted to powerful virtual reality fantasies that they will do anything to continue them.

episodes.title: Rats!
episodes.summary: Terry and Dana's relationship is strained when Terry's Batman duties get in the way of their relationship. Receiving a flower, Dana believes it's from Terry but comes to realize it's from an unexpected stalker.. with some unexpected friends.

episodes.title: Mind Games
episodes.summary: A young girl with telepathic powers calls to Batman for help.

episodes.title: Revenant
episodes.summary: McGinnis' high school seems to be haunted by a poltergeist.

episodes.title: Babel
episodes.summary: In order to have his revenge, Shriek makes the speech of the population of Gotham City incomprehensible and demands Batman surrendered to him to stop the chaos.

episodes.title: Terry's Friend Dates a Robot
episodes.summary: A status-seeking nerd illegally buys a robot girlfriend, only to have it become dangerously jealous.

episodes.title: Eyewitness
episodes.summary: When Commissioner Barbara Gordon sees Batman committing murder, she initiates an all-out manhunt for him while Bruce Wayne investigates what really happened.

episodes.title: Final Cut
episodes.summary: Batman is blackmailed by a bomb threat to protect a member of the Society of Assassins from Curaré.

episodes.title: The Last Resort
episodes.summary: Terry investigates a troubled child reform camp that is more like a prison.

episodes.title: Armory
episodes.summary: To support his family, a desperately unemployed advanced weapons engineer must steal vital materials for an illegal arms deal and elude Batman to do it.

episodes.title: Sneak Peek
episodes.summary: An arrogantly intrusive reporter with a special ability to become intangible discovers Terry and Bruce's big secret.

episodes.title: The Eggbaby
episodes.summary: Terry has a school project where he must constantly care for a baby simulator, even when he's out in the field as Batman.

episodes.title: Zeta
episodes.summary: Batman meets a good-hearted artificially intelligent robot assassin on the run from his creators.

episodes.title: Plague
episodes.summary: Batman and Stalker must work together to stop the Kobra cult from unleashing a fearsome bioweapon on the populous.

episodes.title: April Moon
episodes.summary: Batman must battle a gang of cyborgs made possible by blackmailing a bionics specialist.

episodes.title: Sentries of the Last Cosmos
episodes.summary: Ardent players of an in-depth virtual reality role-playing game are recruited by the supposed creator of the game for his own purposes.

episodes.title: Payback
episodes.summary: Batman investigates a mysterious vigilante who is somehow linked to a teens' counseling center and wants to attack people who torment them.

episodes.title: Where's Terry?
episodes.summary: When Terry goes missing, Wayne and Max go searching for him.

episodes.title: Ace in the Hole
episodes.summary: When Ace spots the man who abused him into becoming a sport fighting dog, he chases him and gets lost from his guardians.

episodes.title: King's Ransom
episodes.summary: Reduced to doing Paxton Power's dirty work, The Royal Flush Gang begins to fall apart while Batman has to clean up the mess.

episodes.title: Untouchable
episodes.summary: Batman hunts for a mysterious criminal with a personal repulsion field and one of the occupants of a medical research lab may be that person.

episodes.title: Inqueling
episodes.summary: Seriously wounded in a doublecross, Inque approaches her estranged daughter for help.

episodes.title: Big Time
episodes.summary: An old reprobate childhood friend of Terry returns with a half-baked plan to become a big-time criminal.

episodes.title: Out of the Past
episodes.summary: Talia arrives in Gotham claiming she has mastered the Lazarus Pit and offers to use it to restore Bruce's youth without any side affects. But all is not as it seems.

episodes.title: Speak No Evil
episodes.summary: A genetically enhanced gorilla enlists Batman's help to hunt his kidnappers.

episodes.title: The Call (1)
episodes.summary: Superman comes for a visit to offer Terry membership in the Justice League. Superman needs Batman's help to find a traitor in the League.

episodes.title: The Call (2)
episodes.summary: The identity of the traitor is revealed, which set the stage for a confrontation.

episodes.title: Betrayal
episodes.summary: Escaped from prison, Big Time attempts to recruit Terry as his partner in crime.

episodes.title: Curse of Kobra (1)
episodes.summary: Terry goes for advanced martial arts training at a special dojo, but there is far more to one of his fellow students than he realizes.

episodes.title: Curse of Kobra (2)
episodes.summary: After being seriously injured trying to stop Zander of the Kobra cult from kidnapping Max as his bride, Terry is still determined to stop him and his ultimate scheme.

episodes.title: Countdown
episodes.summary: When Zeta and Ro come to Gotham City, the android finds himself separated and manipulated by Mad Stan into one of his terrorist bombing schemes.

episodes.title: Unmasked
episodes.summary: Terry explains to Max why he needs a secret identity by telling the story of the trouble caused when he revealed it to a small boy who is then kidnapped by Kobra to interrogate him.
